_help: Copy to keys.json (outside git) and fill what you have. Empty values or values starting with REPLACE are skipped, so you can run it again later. Run: bench --site <site> execute vintraxo_tcd.core.server_keys.apply_keys --kwargs "{'path': '/home/<user>/keys.json'}"

email._help: Outgoing mail (Gmail/Workspace: smtp.gmail.com 587 + an App Password).

runner._help: Judge0 server for Java/C#/C++... Install it with deploy/judge0/install_judge0.sh on a SEPARATE server; it prints url and token. Leave empty to keep browser languages only.

zoom._help: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth app (marketplace.zoom.us). Fill zoom OR google_meet.

google_meet._help: Name of a Google Calendar already connected from the Desk (Google Settings + Google Calendar).

payment._help: Name of a Payment Gateway record (payments app). Put the gateway's own keys under documents.

github._help: Per space: sync its pages with a GitHub repo. Key = space name.

documents._help: Keys kept by other apps, e.g. Stripe Settings or Google Settings. Field names as in the Desk form.
